verdict.rationale: Weave documents an official W&B MCP Server that lets coding agents and chat assistants answer questions about runs, traces, evaluations and artifacts. It also offers a REST Service API with a full OpenAPI spec that includes call query endpoints, and W&B Skills that let agents such as Claude Code read production data and run evaluations. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents successfully debugging through the MCP server or API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent query my traces, metrics, and eval results through an API or MCP server to debug my app

citations.quote: The W\&B MCP Server gives your IDE, coding assistant, or chat agent direct access to your W\&B data and documentation... your agent can answer questions about your runs, traces, evaluations, and artifacts without copy-paste.
Using W&B skills and the MCP server, coding agents like Claude Code connect to Weave. They can read live production data, run evaluations, and execute automatic iteration loops on their own
Use the Weave Service API, which provides REST endpoints for programmatic access to Weave functionality.

The Weave trace API host serves a complete machine-readable OpenAPI 3.1.0 document at the well-known path, covering the full service surface (117 paths, including /call/start and /calls/stream_query).
